sentences.en: We can't see the aeroplane, but we can hear it.
sentences.zh: 我们看不见那架飞机，但能听到它的声音。

sentences.en: We used to have aeroplanes, but we had to sell them.
sentences.zh: 我们以前有飞机，但不得不把它们卖了。

sentences.en: He sat stuck between a rowdy elderly couple on the aeroplane.
sentences.zh: 他在飞机上被一对吵闹的老夫妇夹在中间，动弹不得。
